summary.text: Greg Rothman is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 34, covering Cumberland and Perry counties and northern Dauphin County, since his election in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He chairs the Senate Game and Fisheries Committee.

paragraphs.text: Greg Rothman is a graduate of Cumberland Valley High School, holds an undergraduate degree in political science from the University of Massachusetts Amherst, and has a Master of Science in real estate from Johns Hopkins University, according to his official biography.
He enlisted in the Marine Corps during Operation Desert Storm, served nearly 10 years in the Marine Corps Reserve, and was honorably discharged in 2001 as a staff sergeant.
He is the former president and CEO of RSR REALTORS, where he began as a real estate sales agent in 1989.
Before the Senate, Rothman represented the 87th Legislative District in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives.

In the Senate he chairs the Game and Fisheries Committee and is a member of the Agriculture and Rural Affairs; Banking and Insurance; Education; Finance; Rules and Executive Nominations; and Transportation committees.
He is a former trustee of Harrisburg University of Science and Technology and one of the five founders of the Harrisburg Young Professionals.
